methodology.signal: App actual after-close picks stored before future outcomes
methodology.weights: equally weighted, names fixed per cohort
methodology.costs: estimated stock round-trip 0.585%, ETF round-trip 0.385% before broker discount
methodology.selection: exclude all incomplete cohorts with explicit missing reason; do not replace missing prices with zero or survivors
methodology.samples: daily cohorts overlap; cohort averages are not independent samples nor compoundable portfolio returns
methodology.adjustment: cash dividends, corporate actions, intraday execution and slippage omitted

warnings: Requires prospective data after first logged recommendation date
No Sharpe or statistical significance is published until sufficient independent history
Being selected by an App is a research observation, not an executed order
